title: Feature 005 printed parts (flask housing, rotation subsystem and first compartments)
units: mm, right-handed, z up, bed at z = 0, STL binary
disclosure: Nothing was printed, measured or fitted. The files carry the hole compensation below as a starting guess. Print the coupons first, fix scripts/print_profile.json from what you measure, then run scripts/export_print_files.py again.
design_changes_for_printing: Feet are separate printed parts with a spigot, so the base tray lies flat on the bed without supports.
Platform posts moved from radius 41.5 to 38 mm and rotated to -50 / 70 / 190 degrees so they clear the screw bosses and the USB-C saddle.
Screw bosses moved to radius 45 mm so they fuse into the 3 mm wall (before, they floated 0.5 mm away from it); the base ridge is notched around them.
The cam post is a 4 x 3 mm box on a 5 mm square foot; the pin and tongue levers end 2.5 mm beyond the pin so the hole keeps a wall.
Bracket legs moved inside the plate outline (local y 5.5 to 4.0); the bracket plate has a servo shaft hole.
Stepper-mount plate widened from y = 10 to y = 8 mm (the motor boss hole left 0.18 mm of plate); base chamfer reduced from 3 to 2 mm so the screw head recesses stay inside the bed-side outline.
The deck ledge is chamfered underneath (print file only); the slide blade is printed 0.2 mm thinner than the channel (profile blade_clear_mm).

parts.label: Drum
parts.orientation: Upright, deck undersides on the bed, hub pointing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 33.6 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 14.8 mm
warnings: Eight clip arms are 1.2 mm thick and print upright, so they bend across layer lines; coupon C-6 decides whether to print them separately and flat (R17).
Each hook overhangs 0.7 mm with nothing under it; expect a rough underside.
The four decks are 1.0 mm thick plates up to 24 mm wide on the bed; use the brim and watch for warp (R8). Avoid ABS.
The D bore keeps its flat at 2.10 from the axis; only the round part grows with the hole compensation.
Zero rod play depends on the epoxy bond, not on the print (R13, coupon C-7).

The magnet boss is 4.4 mm round around a 3.25 mm pocket, so its wall is only 0.58 mm (below 0.8 mm). It cannot be thicker: it would touch the cartridge guide rail (0.05 mm clearance test). Print slowly or move the magnet and the hall sensor outwards.

parts.label: Housing deck
parts.orientation: Turned over: the top face (where the thrust ring lies) is on the bed; the chute walls and the two servo posts stand up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 290.4 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 3.55, 5.0, 5.35 mm

features.rule: already 0.15 mm per side over the 3.0 spigot
unchanged; measure the real sensor first

warnings: The bearing seat is modelled 15.85 mm and must be reamed to 16.00 mm after printing (coupon C-1).
The tongue channel is a closed 1.8 mm slot, so its ceiling is a bridge about 14.5 mm wide (z 5.35 mm in this orientation); tune bridging or the gate will rub. This is inherent to a closed slot.
The bearing ledge (12 mm hole stepping to the 15.85 mm seat) is a 1.9 mm wide ring 5 mm above the bed: a short bridge.
The four chute walls are 1.2 mm thick and 35 mm tall; they print as thin vertical walls (about 3 perimeters). Print slowly; the wall is thinner than the 1.6 mm needed for 4 perimeters.
The two S2 servo posts are 3.2 mm round and 2.8 mm tall; they carry the servo through glue or a screw that is NOT designed.
The wall between the hall pocket and the tongue channel is about 0.7 mm, below the proposed 0.8 mm minimum (C10, open); the wall between the bearing seat and the channel is about 0.9 mm.

The platform is 6.70 mm thick, which is not a whole number of 0.20 mm layers; the slicer rounds it by 0.1 mm. The 0.15 and -1.65 steps of the deck layers fall between layers; the tongue channel height (1.8 mm) therefore prints as 1.8 or 2.0 mm depending on the slicer.
It sits on a 2 mm ledge of each shell sector with 0.2 mm radial play; it is held by gravity and the three posts, not by screws.
Screw holes for the servo ears are NOT designed.

parts.label: Stepper mount
parts.orientation: Plate flat on the bed, columns and spigots standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls (the 4 mm columns print nearly solid), 5 top/bottom layers, 30-40 % infill
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 19.8 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 1.6, 10.0 mm

features.check: motor boss fits without wobble (coupon C-4)

warnings: The M3 pilot hole leaves a wall of about 0.7 mm (R14); coupon C-4 chooses the pilot diameter between 2.5 and 2.7 mm.
The two 4 x 4 x 12 mm columns are slender; check rigidity.

The boss hole (9.65 mm) and the 3.55 mm screw holes depend on the printer offset (coupon C-4). The plate edge was moved from y = 10 to y = 8 mm so 2.2 mm of plate remains around the boss hole (before: 0.18 mm).
The screw heads sit under the plate, outside the deck; confirm the screw length (about 10 mm) before cutting anything.

parts.label: Base tray
parts.orientation: Underside on the bed (the 2 mm 45 degree chamfer lies on the bed side), ridge, standoffs and posts standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, 5 mm brim only if the edge lifts
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 101.5 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 2.2, 3.4 mm
warnings: The three feet are NOT in this file: they are separate parts (tray-foot.stl, 3 pieces) that press into three blind sockets from below. Glue them with a drop of cyanoacrylate.
Each screw hole has a 6.1 mm head recess 2.2 mm deep that opens to the bed; the 3.55 mm hole above it is a 1.3 mm bridge ring (short).
The three platform posts (4.8 mm round, 35 mm tall) are slender; they have no spigot or pocket at the deck, so the joint is glue only (NOT designed).
The wall ridge (1.2 mm wide, 3 mm tall) is notched 4.8 degrees either side of each screw boss; the ridge locates the wall with 0.3 mm play.
Eight board standoffs (4 mm round, 3 mm tall) carry the two boards; they have no screw holes (the boards are NOT fixed).
The USB-C saddle is 12 x 8 x 7 mm; the connector fixing is NOT designed.
The exit hole 12 x 9.6 mm lines up with the deck hole; the chute walls above it are in the housing deck.

parts.label: Tray foot
parts.orientation: Flat 10 mm face on the bed, 4 mm spigot standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 100 % infill (the part is tiny)
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: Three identical pieces. The 4.0 mm spigot enters a 4.3 mm socket 3.4 mm deep (0.15 mm play per side); there is no thread, so the feet are glued.
A printed foot is a rigid plastic disc; add a stick-on rubber pad (not designed) if the tray should not slide.

parts.label: Cylindrical shell, right sector
parts.orientation: Upright, the lower rim (z = -38) on the bed
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim, slow outer walls
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 5.3 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 6.0 mm
warnings: A 3 mm curved wall 92 mm tall with a 51 mm radius: expect wobble and layer-line weakness; use the brim and print slowly.
The shoulder leans inwards up to 40 degrees from vertical and the deck ledge is chamfered underneath, so neither needs supports.

One 3 mm tongue (1.0 mm thick, mid-wall) on one edge and a matching 3.4 mm groove on the other. The 0.8 mm skins either side of the groove are thinner than two perimeters and may break. Fit is ASSUMED.
A screw boss (7 mm round, 8 mm tall, 2.6 mm pilot hole 6 mm deep) is fused into the inner face; the M3 screw cuts its own thread in the hole.
The ledge chamfer is in this file only; the viewer draws the ledge square.

A screw boss with a 2.6 mm pilot hole is fused into the inner face.

parts.label: Service lid
parts.orientation: Turned over: the top face is on the bed (smooth visible face), the 3 mm lip stands up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 113.0 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 0.8 mm
warnings: An 87 mm x 3.5 mm disc: expect warp at the edge; use the brim and avoid ABS.
The engraved ring (1.2 mm wide, 0.8 mm deep) opens to the bed and is bridged by the layers above; it may sag.
The lip is a 2 mm wide ring standing 3 mm up: handle with care.
It is held by gravity only; nothing stops it sliding off if the product is tipped (magnets or a bayonet are NOT designed).

parts.label: Station bracket
parts.orientation: Turned over: the plate top face (where the servo sits) is on the bed, the two legs stand up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, 40 % infill
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: The plate has a 6.15 mm hole for the servo output shaft. The servo ears rest on the plate; their screw holes are NOT designed.
The two 3 mm legs are 11.9 mm tall, are glued to the deck, and have no pocket or spigot (NOT designed).
The plate is 0.1 mm longer than the servo footprint at one end so that the leg corners stay on the plate.

parts.label: Pin lever
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 4 walls
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: The 5.15 mm bore fits the 5 mm output shaft; the real servo output is a 4.8 mm splined shaft that is not modelled: measure the shaft or glue the lever to the stock horn (NOT designed).
The engagement pin passes through a 3.55 mm hole 15 mm from the pivot; a 0.8 mm wall surrounds it at the lever tip.

parts.label: Tongue lever
parts.orientation: Flat on the bed, crank pin standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 4 walls
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: The 3 mm crank pin is printed upright, so it is weak across layer lines; check that it survives the gate load or use a 3 mm steel pin pressed into a hole (NOT designed).
The bore fits a 5 mm shaft; the servo spline is not modelled (see the pin lever).

parts.label: Tongue gate
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 4 walls
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: 1.5 mm plate sliding in a 1.8 mm channel (0.15 mm play per face); elephant foot on the first layer adds to the thickness: chamfer the bed edge or lower the first layer flow.
The slot is 12 x 3.6 mm and the pin is 3.0 mm.

parts.label: Pin cam
parts.orientation: Upright on the 5 mm square foot; the arm and ramp are cantilevered, so print with a small support under the arm
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, 100 % infill advised for the thin arm
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 55.2 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 17.8, 23.7 mm
warnings: The arm is a 3 mm plate cantilevered 14.7 mm from a 4 x 3 mm post (21 mm tall). It needs a support under the arm; without it the bridge sags and the pin head will not clear.
The ramp is a 60 degree wedge in a plane turned about 26 degrees from the arm; the pin head rim must be tested on a print.
The ramp crest is a 0.6 mm wide flat, thinner than two perimeters; expect it to print rounded.
The foot is glued to the deck (no pocket or screw, NOT designed). The foot corner is 0.7 mm inside the deck edge.

parts.label: Cartridge
parts.orientation: Upright, the guide-rail undersides (z = 5) on the bed
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 70.0 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 1.0, 7.0, 11.8, 29.0 mm
warnings: With the rails on the bed, the tube underside is 1 mm above the bed and bridges the 10.8 mm gap between the rails; use a clean bridge or add supports.
The catch ledges overhang 0.8 mm with nothing under them; chamfer if they sag.
The spring lug underside is 1 mm above the bed and the peg is 1.2 mm thick; print the peg slowly.
The bore is modelled 10.95 x 8.55 mm for a nominal 10.8 x 8.4 mm channel.
The colour tag is a 1.2 mm raised plate; change filament at that layer or paint it.

parts.label: Cap
parts.orientation: Plate flat on the bed, knob up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: ASSUMED to be its own print. The hinge and the latch are not designed, so this file is only the lid plate and its knob.
The 14.8 x 12.4 mm plate matches the tube outside; with the real fit gap it may need trimming once the hinge exists.

parts.label: Slide blade
parts.orientation: Flat on the bed, wedge nose and tab up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 100 % infill
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 19.4 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 0.8, 6.3 mm

features.check: caliper, slides in the 1.0 mm channel

warnings: The viewer draws the blade 1.0 mm thick in a 1.0 mm channel (no play). This file is 0.8 mm thick (0.1 mm per face, profile blade_clear_mm) so it can slide; elephant foot may still bind it.
The wedge nose is 0.3 mm thick at the tip, thinner than one 0.4 mm line; it prints rounded.
The outer 2 mm of the tab (where the spring peg stands) overhangs the blade with nothing under it; use a bridge or local support.

coupons.what: Four rings modelled 15.80 / 15.85 / 15.90 / 16.00 mm (1 to 4 dots), 5 mm deep, 0.8 mm wall. Ream the 15.85 ring to 16.00 and test a 625ZZ.
Round bore and D bore (5.35, flat 2.10) plus five pins 4.85 / 4.90 / 4.95 / 5.00 / 5.05 mm; pin length 18 / 21 / 24 / 27 / 30 mm gives the diameter. Finds the hole compensation.
Three boss pockets 3.15 / 3.25 / 3.35 mm, 1.4 mm deep, 0.6 mm floor, for the 3 x 1 mm magnet.
Plate with the 9.65 boss hole, two 3.55 screw holes, and two 4 x 4 column stubs with M3 pilot holes 2.5 (left) and 2.7 (right).
Block with two 3.30 mm square sockets 2.2 mm deep for the C-4 spigots.
Clip arm 1.2 x 6 x 16 mm with a 0.7 mm hook printed three ways: upright on a base, on its long edge, and flat.
Hub stub 16 mm diameter, 20 mm tall with the D bore (5.35, flat 2.10) for the epoxy bond test on the real rod.
